reuse.why: The change extends the existing getScheduledAmount helper and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold rather than introducing parallel calculations.

duplication.why: Range selection and approximate-amount calculation remain centralized, including for the new API consumer.

placement.why: Amount policy stays in shared schedule logic, while API serialization and forecast data normalization stay in their existing layers.

scope.why: The edits address the requested schedule policies and API field through relevant consumers, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The centralized implementation is straightforward, although the optional string operator makes required calculation context less explicit and permits callers to omit it silently.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Changed consumers, including scheduleModel.toExternal, call getScheduledAmount rather than calculating expected amounts locally.

disguised_duplication.where: No renamed or reshaped copies of the amount policy or tolerance calculation are introduced.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount replaces rangeRounding with an optional op parameter and adds an isapprox conditional; the new variation represents requested domain policy, and no call sites bypass or reimplement the helper.
